programmes.d: Yugi and his friends must stop KaibaCorp island from exploding.
Tea and Serenity explore the town of Domino and reminisce about battles.
Three Egyptian god cards are stolen as a new villain emerges.
Yugi tries to defend himself against Gurimo and ten creatures who have received power boosts.
Guardians of earth and the monster domain must work together.
A former foe asks Yugi and the gang for help.
Kaiba takes part in a showdown against Pegasus.

Not only does Alister's mighty fiend gain attack points for every fiery monster on the field, but it can also take control of Kaiba's monsters! With Alister's army growing while Kaiba's squad whittles into nothing, will Alister get his revenge?
A group of motorcyclists ambushes Yogi and the gang.
Mai inexplicably joins the enemy.
Mai uses the Harpie Ladies against Joey's forces.
Joey turns time wizard into a hammer.
Professor Hawkins finds links between the Orichalcos stones and a lost civilization.
Yugi faces Rafael and his monsters.
Yugi struggles to save humanity.
Yugi defeats Rafael's guardians.
Dartz captures Yugi's soul.
During a cross-country expedition, Dartz's new duelists separate Joey and Yugi in hopes of capturing their souls separately.

Weevil sneakily infests and genetically manipulates Yugi's monsters to metamorphose them into crude creepy crawlers; Rex Raptor's prehistoric predators take a more forceful approach and run roughshod over Joey's forces.
After losing faith in Timaeus, Yugi discovers that he can no longer use his powerful guardian dragon against Weevil's insect invasion; discouraged and confused, Yugi has lost his duelling instincts.
Yami and Tea's train crashes, and they meet the mysterious Ironheart.
Ironheart tries to help Yugi battle Dartz.
Valon fights for Mai's heart.
Alistar battles Kariba on top of an out-of-control airplane.
Alistair unleashes an airborne arsenal that includes countless armed cannons and a battalion of robot tokens.
Preparing to punish unwanted intruders.
Dartz sets the final phase of his plan into motion.
Valon uses high-tech armor during a battle with Joey.
Joey tries to fight back against Valon and his scientifically advanced armor.
Valon and Joey's battle reaches a dramatic climax.
Still exhausted from his battle against Valon, Joey must duel Mai.
The Pharaoh and Rafael face off again.
Rafael employs the powers of the Seal of Orichalcos to defeat Pharaoh.
Rafael uses the unbeatable Guardian Dreadscythe to fight Pharaoh.
The navy joins the heroes in an effort to stop Dartz at his secret ocean base.
New information about Dartz reveals how much is at stake in the battle.
Dartz uses the captured souls as puppets to fight the Pharaoh and Kaiba.
Dartz uses a multipronged attack.
Pharaoh must fend for himself after the capture of Kaiba's soul.
With the last of Echo's duel energy at stake, Aster Phoenix looks to change her fate with his deck of Destiny Heroes.
Hoping to teach his friend a valuable lesson, Zane challenges Jaden to a heart-pounding duel.
Disguised as Jesse, Yubel faces off against Zane in a confrontation with dramatic consequences.
Zane tries to make one last push to free Jesse from Yubel's mind-control before his conscience forces him to surrender.
Jaden crosses the gate with Syrus and Crowler; with the power of Exodia by his side, Adrian Gecko takes on Yubel in a duel.
The clash between Adrian and Yubel continues as Adrian attempts to unleash the Ultimate Forbidden One.
Jaden duels Jesse to try to break Yubel's control over him, but worries about the consequences a victory would cause for Jesse's safety.
With the help of his Elemental Heroes, Jaden tries to free Jesse's spirit from Yubel's control.
With Jesse safe and sound, Jaden agrees to settle the score with Yubel, once and for all.
Jaden tries to deal the final blow to Yubel and save his friends using cards from Jesse's deck and the Supreme King.
